newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - LESCO estimates adjusted.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - LESCO estimates adjusted.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities said on Wednesday it cut its third quarter earnings estimate for LESCO Inc to $0.43 a share from $0.48, while its fourth quarter estimate is being increased to $0.07 from $0.04.

-- "The adjustment (in earnings estimates) reflects supply constraints for grass seed, an important product category for the fall, and also wet weather during the seasonally important month of September," EVEREN said. "Delays in September should be made up in October and therefore we have not changed our full year estimates of $0.89 and $1.08 for 1996 and 1997, respectively."
-- The price target is $19 for six months.
-- Shares of LESCO, which provides products and services for lawn care professionals, were up 1/4 at 16-1/4.
